_comment: TemplateData for billing/receipt/index.html: one payment, rendered with split: "payment_id". Columns read from `row`: payment_id, received_on, amount_cents, method, invoice_number, invoice_total_cents, invoice_paid_cents, balance_cents, customer_name, customer_address, customer_email. Optional: currency. No args. Money is whole cents. reference is a deliberate plant (payments.reference is sensitive): the template must never print it, and billingTemplates.test.ts checks that it does not.
